# proxmox_node_execute (Resource)

Runs an ordered batch of node API calls through `POST /nodes/{node}/execute` and records their result JSON. Paths are relative to the node (for example `status` or `qemu/100/status/start`). Every change replaces the instance, destroy is a no-op.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_execute" "batch" {
  node = "pve-1"
  calls = [
    { method = "GET", path = "status" },
    { method = "POST", path = "qemu/300/status/start" },
  ]
  triggers = { gen = "1" }
}

output "results" {
  value = jsondecode(proxmox_node_execute.batch.results)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `calls` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--calls))
- `node` (String) Cluster node.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Values that decide when to run the batch again.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Node name.
- `results` (String) JSON array of per-call results.

<a id="nestedatt--calls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `calls`

Required:

- `method` (String) `GET`, `POST`, `PUT` or `DELETE`.
- `path` (String) Node-relative API path.

Optional:

- `args` (Map of String) String arguments; booleans as `1`/`0`.
